visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men stand on a modern apartment balcony during the daytime. One man wears a light blue button-down shirt and glasses, while the other wears a black sweater and glasses. Beside them is a standalone white oval bathtub placed on a bed of white pebbles next to a wooden deck. The background shows a panoramic view of a dense urban skyline with skyscrapers. (2) An establishing shot shows the exterior of three sleek, grey high-rise residential towers with glass balconies against a clear blue sky. The architecture is modern with geometric lines. (3) Inside an elevator lobby, the walls are paneled in light wood with several framed abstract artworks hanging. A man in black stands near a large dark door. A green cactus sculpture and a modern low bench with lighting underneath are visible. (4) The scene shifts to a vast open-plan living and dining space with light wood flooring. A long white dining table with multiple white chairs sits under a large spherical pendant lamp. Large floor-to-ceiling windows with blinds line the far wall, flooding the room with natural light. The men walk through the space gesturing. (5) The two men walk through the 'Diamond Corner' seating area, which features a sunken grey couch layout integrated into the wooden floor, surrounded by wrap-around glass windows offering a 270-degree city view. (6) A modern kitchen area is shown with a long white marble island, gold-tone bar stools, and three white dome pendant lights. Wooden cabinetry and high-end built-in appliances are seen in the background. (7) A master bedroom features a large bed dressed in white linens. A tabby cat sleeps in a clear plastic hemisphere mounted on the large window frame. (8) A man in a blue shirt walks towards a glass door leading back to a balcony area, showing the transition between indoor and outdoor living.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, mid-tempo electronic pop track featuring synth melodies and a steady kick drum beat. A male voice speaks with high arousal and a bright, excited tone, expressing amazement. The second male voice responds in a calmer, informative professional tone, explaining the design features. (2) As the men move through the apartment, the conversation remains high-density and well-enunciated. Ambient indoor room tone is minimal, maintaining a clear signal. Subtle percussive impacts from footsteps on wood floors are heard intermittently. (3) A brief synth riser transition occurs during the exterior shot of the building, followed by a return to the conversational flow. The BGM maintains a consistent 'major' tonality, reinforcing a positive and upbeat mood. (4) In the bedroom phase, the acoustics change slightly, suggesting a smaller space with soft surfaces, reducing the slight reverb from the larger living area. The dialogue concludes with a joking tone about the cost of the apartment, accompanied by light laughter from the speakers.
